728-2866-4808-4986.description:
Cast Black Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Black Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2111-2921-6792.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

719-4369-7855.notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on The Red Terror.
719-4369-7855.description:
Put a counter on The Red Terror.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as The Red Terror is a Goblin, Orc or Army due to Xenograft, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-6723-6968-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

511-817-4050-6705-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
511-817-4050-6705-7803.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient due to Brad Boimler.
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token plus an additional creature token due to Quina.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 1.

1619-2511-4605-5542-6154.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6154.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning White Plume Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the White Plume Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6154.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

670-1619-1734-6142.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-1734-6142.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Eccentric Apprentice.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, it triggers, returning Eccentric Apprentice from exile to the battlefield.
When Eccentric Apprentice enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Eccentric Apprentice trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Eccentric Apprentice.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-4613-4679-7747--128.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
2034-4613-4679-7747--128.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
2034-4613-4679-7747--128.description:
Activate Giant-Sized Flying Ant using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Giant-Sized Flying Ant to Yenna and causing Giant-Sized Flying Ant to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Giant-Sized Flying Ant.
When the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2908-4986-5256--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Dream Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dream Stalker
Repeat.
2908-4986-5256--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

4050-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1169-3259-3986.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
1169-3259-3986.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1475-2292-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland creature with power 1 or greater that does not have One with the Kami attached to it.
1475-2292-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and One with the Kami trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the land's power.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4120-4968-7061.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4120-4968-7061.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
4120-4968-7061.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

141-997-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

147-966-4191.easyPrerequisites: There are applicable target(s) for Unsubstantiate.
147-966-4191.description:
Cast Unsubstantiate by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Unsubstantiate, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Unsubstantiate copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

549-856-1477-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1286-5686-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1286-5686-5972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2760-3108-3122.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Undercover Operative.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Undercover Operative by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2639-3254-4050-5463.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-4050-5463.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Nurturing Pixie and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nurturing Pixie enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Nurturing Pixie and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-4050-5463.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

527-542-3480.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-3480.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

122-328-997-2732.description:
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant die, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers twice, exiling Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from your graveyard.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from exile to the battlefield.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Gray Merchant trigger, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, causing you to return Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose 4 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

2523-5231-5560.notablePrerequisites: Rangers of Ithilien is your Ring-bearer.
2523-5231-5560.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Rangers of Ithilien, adding {R}.
When Rangers of Ithilien dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Rangers of Ithilien that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Rangers of Ithilien token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Rangers of Ithilien token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

3430-4499-5478-5954.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Spelunking.
Activate the Everywhere token by tapping it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2249-3192-5231.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2249-3192-5231.description:
Activate Ulasht's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {R}.
When the Saproling dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Repeat.

369-539-1258-1315.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Abduction triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability from step 1, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

2113-4687-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Gilder Bairn.
Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
2113-4687-4893.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

643-1486-3337-4284.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Reflection of Kiki-Jiki's ability, creating a token copy of other Reflection of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1039-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Teardrop Kami.
Teardrop Kami does not have summoning sickness.
1039-4702.description:
Activate Teardrop Kami by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
Activate the Teardrop Kami token by sacrificing it, untapping the nontoken Teardrop Kami.
Repeat.

643-4050-4242-4640.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding one mana of any color.
Su-Chi and Oathkeeper triggers.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Oathkeeper trigger, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield.
Equip Oathkeeper to Su-Chi by paying {2}.
Repeat.

1958-2428-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Prophetic Ravings attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
At least one card in hand.
1958-2428-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to discard a card and draw a card.
When you draw a card, Horizon Chimera will trigger, gaining you 1 life.
Gaining the life untaps Famished Paladin.
Repeat.

65-717-864-2628-4606.description:
Activate Sheltered Thicket's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Sheltered Thicket, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Sheltered Thicket trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Sheltered Thicket from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
